newsitem.title: UK: Bakery Services posts premium on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Bakery Services posts premium on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in in-store bakery operator Bakery Services Plc rose to a premium on Monday in their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market, dealers said.
Bakery Services shares, issued at 3p, gained 3/4p to 3-3/4p by 1401 GMT.
Dealers estimated the volume to be over 12.5 million shares, 12 million of which was an agency cross - where a brokerage matches a buy and sell order from two different clients.
"We have seen a steady stream of buyers for the stock," said one dealer.
The company operates bakeries in UK food retailing stores such as the Co-op and Roys (Wroxham) Ltd.
Bakery Services, which is valued at around 2.2 million stg, raised about 780,000 stg from a placing and said it would use the funds to reduce gearing and to expand its business.
